# Shop 1.4

Released 2026-11-20.

This release adds gift wrapping and a cart that survives between visits, fixes
two pricing bugs, and cleans up a few rough edges.

## New

- Add gift wrapping at checkout (#44)
- Save the cart between visits (#46)

## Fixes

- Coupon codes are no longer case sensitive (#41)
- Totals are correct for empty carts (#42)

## Changes

- Prices are shown with two decimals everywhere (#43)

## Performance

- The product list is loaded in one query (#45)

## Internal

- Bumped the test timeout and removed an unused import.
